label: happy
stance: Small daily joy — walk, light, being known by name · ML samples: 3
passage: For me — I go get a coffee, and to me that's happy. I get to see the leaves, the way the sun comes through. Maybe a pretty girl walks by. Maybe a little child walks by with their mother. That makes me happy. Sitting in the coffee shop — I know Alex, I know Liz, I know Zai, Ari — I know their names, they know my name. That makes me happy. It's somewhere in between happy and neutral.
